title: Origins of the Square-Root Law for Covert Quantum Communication and Its Photon Bound
question: What is the primary source of the square-root law for covert quantum communication, and how does it bound the signal that can be sent without detection by a photon-counting warden?

title: Mechanisms Limiting Long-Run Entanglement Attempt Rates: Cooling, Detector Recovery, Signalling and Covert Scheduling
question: Which physical or operational mechanisms limit the long-run average number of entanglement-generation attempts in a quantum network link over many time slots (for example source duty cycle, ion heating and recooling, detector recovery, or covertness against a warden), as opposed to limits within a single attempt?

title: Quantum Switch Scheduling for Shared Users: Age Objectives, Memory Limits, and Rate Constraints
question: Has any published work scheduled entanglement distribution at a quantum switch or hub that serves two bipartite requests sharing one user (for example A–B and A–C), where the hub chooses the swap partner from the age of the stored link, minimizes the age of entanglement under a memory cutoff, and adds a long-run delivery-rate floor and an attempt budget? Has this been studied for underwater optical quantum links?

title: Heralded entanglement between remote quantum memories: reported experiments, fidelities, rates and storage times
question: Which experiments have demonstrated heralded entanglement between two remote quantum memories, and what herald rate, Bell-state fidelity and storage time of the entangled state did each report?
